[blue]I[#8abcd1]L[#654321]I[highlight]测测Build反病毒[white]

[gray]替换掉试图控制单位建造1*1建筑的逻辑
由于Poly会自动重建，所以在Poly杀毒完成后会被此逻辑强制控制，开关用于解控

Anti-Virus-logic Logic

Replaces logic that attempts to control units into building 1×1 structures.

Since Poly units automatically rebuild virious, they will be forcibly controlled by this logic after the cleanup is complete.

The switch can be used to release control.
